definitions.explanation: The night or evening of the previous day. Can also be written as {昨夜|ゆうべ}.

examples.japanese: ゆうべは{何|なに}をしましたか。
examples.english: What did you do last night?

examples.japanese: ゆうべよく{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't sleep well last night.

examples.japanese: ゆうべの{映画|えいが}は{面白|おもしろ}かった。
examples.english: The movie last night was interesting.

examples.japanese: ゆうべは{友達|ともだち}と{食事|しょくじ}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: Last night I went out to eat with a friend.

examples.japanese: ゆうべ{遅|おそ}くまで{勉強|べんきょう}していたので、{今日|きょう}はとても{眠|ねむ}い。
examples.english: I was studying until late last night, so I'm very sleepy today.

notes:
Time word referring to the previous night. Usually written in hiragana but can also be {昨夜|ゆうべ}. Note that {昨夜|さくや} is a more formal reading.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
・{今夜|こんや} (tonight)
・おととい (day before yesterday)
・{昨日|きのう} (yesterday)
・{明日|あした} (tomorrow)
・あさって (day after tomorrow)
